text:
Hi everyone! Quick question for anyone who has travelled outside Israel.

I currently have two visa stamps in my passport:

1. A B/1 Temporary Working Permit, valid until x/x/2027.
2. A State of Israel Entry Visa, category B/1 / Temporary Working Permit, also valid until x/x/2027, which says “No. of Entries: M.”

I’m travelling abroad this Friday and just want to make sure: is this everything I need to leave Israel and re-enter?

I understand that “M” means multiple entries, but I’d love confirmation from someone in the same mixed-couple B/1 process who has travelled with these same stamps.

Do I need anything else, such as a separate inter-visa/re-entry permit, or am I good to travel with these two different stamps I have?

Thank you very much!!
